description: See every worktree your parallel agents work in, review what each one changed, and send your comments back to the agent that made the change. A full-screen Vantage page lists every recent thread's worktrees in bb's sidebar, grouped by what needs doing in plain words (Waiting on you, Ready to review, Still working, Done), and opens the worktree that needs you first, showing its changes as a stream of diffs with a file tree, side-by-side view and expandable context, plus an overlaps page for files two worktrees both changed and an All changes view by repository. Inside a thread, a Vantage tab lists its child threads' worktrees, a folded summary above the composer names the ones that need you, and an Info section shows the counts. Every thread shows its real state and every file has a Reviewed tick, with nothing to turn on; two settings choose the badge and toasts for threads that need you.
